_comment: An L-shaped path, for `watch_control.py gesture --file`. Asymmetric on purpose: a mirrored or rotated frame draws a visibly different letter. Coordinates are fractions of the panel so that it runs on both boards -- it used to be Waveshare pixels, and three of its five points were off the edge of a 240x240 T-Watch, which is the same defect diagnostic_tour.yaml records one directory over.
